what: public single-cell data with RNA and surface protein in the same cells, read for a loop that aims at unseen donors and diseases; assembled 12 Nov 2026 from the pages listed under sources; nothing was downloaded
needs: whole-transcriptome RNA (TEDDY reads the whole transcriptome; targeted panels cannot be embedded)
antibodies that overlap the head's 134 outputs
donor labels, and for a disease claim patients and healthy donors processed in the same study

teddy_pretraining.source: CELLxGENE, downloaded 11 June 2024; 116 million cells after quality control; human and mouse; diseased cells included; datasets used for the paper's downstream tests were removed
teddy_pretraining.consequence: the RNA of any study that was in CELLxGENE by that date may have been seen by TEDDY; its protein was not. This has to be checked per dataset before a claim about TEDDY itself; it does not affect a claim about the head's protein prediction

status_values.checked: taken from a page read on 12 Nov 2026
status_values.recalled: from memory, to be checked before use

reading: Disease with many donors and a large panel exists in the open only for blood in infection: three COVID-19 cohorts with about 190 antibodies each, one of them with sepsis and influenza as well.

No open cohort was found with many cancer or autoimmune patients, whole-transcriptome RNA and a panel above about 50 antibodies. The bone-marrow leukemia sets are either targeted-RNA or have a handful of patients.
The overlap of the 190-antibody COVID-19 panels with the head's 134 outputs is not known until an antibody list is read; the 228-antibody panel of Hao 2021 overlapped 112.
Most large cohorts were public before June 2024, so their RNA may have been in TEDDY's pretraining data. Their protein was not.
